September 22, 2026


The Athabasca Joint Engagement and Environmental Subcommittee (AJES) recently visited our Rabbit Lake Operation to learn more about upcoming reclamation projects. The visit included a tour of D-Zone Pond, which was reclaimed in 2010, and B-Zone Pond, which after approximately 35 years of environmental monitoring, is ready for the next stage of reclamation. Visits like these help reinforce our collaborative and transparent approach to environmental stewardship. By engaging with AJES throughout the reclamation process, we're helping build shared understanding as we work to responsibly manage our sites and protect the environment for future generations.
